reviews.text: Used to take my dog here and he’d come back coughing for days as if he was being choked ,  and the lady was cutting his nails and told me she didn’t have the powder to make them stop bleeding … im confused why am I paying a professional to clip my dogs nails and they’re hurting them and making them bleed. The lady got an attitude about my concern but clearly unprofessional here. Also told them to not shave over my dogs skin tag and it was constantly irritated afterwards. SMH
Awesome staff! They were so gentle and so helpful with trimming our German Shepherd’s nails, he’s big and loud and they did a perfect job with him. Definitely recommend! Thank you!
I like this place. Quick and easy access.

I was pleasantly surprised with Woody's Pet Grooming! I was a walk in on what seemed to be a busy day and they were able to accommodate us! The staff was so kind, welcoming and understanding even though our dog was in bad shape 😬! They offer exceptional services and my Husky never looked and smelled so amazing! We got so many compliments from family and friends! We will definitely be brining him back! Definitely a must!

Dropped off my dog for our appointment at 10 am when they opened and mine was the first dog there. We were told it would be 2 hours and when we came by a little after noon because we were in the area we were told they hadn't gotten to him yet and that it was gonna be another 2 hours. At 3:30 we called and they said it was gonna be 30 more minutes and they finally called at 4:42, 18 minutes before they closed. He smells as if he had no place to potty other than 1 foot away in the same cage and kept him there all day. When we got him, we think it was a rush job because his tail didn't look trimmed at all, his fur was still falling out as if they just shaved him and didn't bathe or even blowdry him.
Took my golden doodle puppy for her first hair cut and she looked sooo pretty! I forgot to take photos but we’ll definitely be back.
